papers.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
papers.desc: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence.

papers.title: ReDesign: Recovering Editable Design Structures from Images via Agentic Decomposition
papers.desc: Recovering an editable design file from a raster image is a common and costly bottleneck in modern design workflows, yet remains challenging since editability depends on recovering multi-modal attributes, such as typography, vector geometry, colors, grouping, and layer ordering.

papers.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: On-policy distillation (OPD) grounds token-level supervision in the student's own trajectory, yet suffers from prefix failure: once the student commits to a wrong reasoning direction, all subsequent generation builds on this deviation, producing misdirected continuations that elicit unreliable supervision and waste compute.

papers.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
papers.desc: Standard vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from Moravec's paradox: they excel at complex offline visual reasoning but struggle with simple streaming perception tasks and process them inefficiently.

papers.title: CodeNib: A Multi-View Data System for Serving Repository Context to Coding Agents
papers.desc: Coding agents repeatedly search, navigate, and retain context from evolving repositories, but disconnected indexes, language servers, and task-local histories force repeated discovery and obscure lifecycle costs.

papers.title: Novel Claim or Déjà Vu? Rethinking "Contamination-Free'' Dynamic Evaluation for Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking
papers.desc: Multimodal automated fact-checking (MAFC) verifies claims by retrieving and reasoning over external evidence.

papers.title: MODUS: Decoder-Only Any-to-Any Modeling of Diverse Modalities
papers.desc: Any-to-any models predict any modality from any combination of others within a single network, a formulation used in multimodal vision and vision-language models, and increasingly in scientific domains such as ecology and astronomy.

papers.title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation
papers.desc: Generation in video diffusion or flow models is computationally expensive due to the slow and iterative sampling process.

papers.title: Where Quality Breaks in Compressed Short-Text Generation: Staged Bottleneck Localization
papers.desc: Compressed short-text generators can fail in two different places: the codec may discard information before generation starts, or the latent generator may produce weak codes.

papers.title: Mapping CVEs to MITRE ATT&CK Techniques: A Curated Gold-Set Classifier and the Limits of LLM-Assisted Label Expansion
papers.desc: We present a reproducible pipeline for mapping Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) to MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise techniques from free-text vulnerability descriptions.

papers.title: VisualPatchWorld: Code World Models as Latent Structured Representations for Planning
papers.desc: Different research lines use the term world model in different ways, yet they share a common aim: to capture how the world evolves under action in a form that supports perception, simulation, and planning.

papers.title: Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control
papers.desc: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting in representation space rather than reconstructing pixels, making them a natural backbone for latent model predictive control from offline demonstration logs.

papers.title: Projection Pursuit CPCANet for Domain Generalization
papers.desc: Domain Generalization (DG) aims to learn representations robust to distribution shifts.

papers.title: Edge-Aware Thermal Infrared UAV Swarm Tracking
papers.desc: Thermal infrared (TIR) imaging is essential for UAV swarm operations in visually degraded environments.

papers.title: GLI-AL: A Multi-Modal Glioma MRI Label Resource with Unified Anatomy-Lesion Labels
papers.desc: Existing BraTS-GLI datasets provide a widely used benchmark for adult glioma MRI segmentation, but their task definition focuses on tumor subregions and does not systematically represent coexisting white matter hyperintensities (WMH).
